name: Match
definition: A single football fixture played between a home team and an away team in one league, one season and one round, carrying the authoritative scoreline home_team_goal and away_team_goal.
scope: Row-level unit of the Match table; the anchor entity for scoreline, odds and event analysis.

name: Team
definition: A football club participating in matches, identified by team_api_id and labelled by team_long_name and team_short_name.
scope: Row-level unit of the Team table; appears in Match as either the home or the away side.

name: Player
definition: A footballer registered in the Player table with his name, birthday, height and weight, and with his FIFA video-game ratings held separately in Player_Attributes.
scope: Row-level unit of the Player table; linked to matches only through the lineup columns of Match.

name: League
definition: A domestic competition, identified by League.id, named by League.name and attached to exactly one Country through League.country_id.
scope: Row-level unit of the League table; 11 competitions, each tied to one country and to one or more seasons of matches.

name: Country
definition: The nation that hosts a league, identified by Country.id and named by Country.name.
scope: Row-level unit of the Country table; referenced by League.country_id and, redundantly but consistently, by Match.country_id.

name: Season
definition: The competition year expressed as a text range in the form 'YYYY/YYYY' in Match.season, covering 2008/2009 through 2015/2016.
scope: Applies to matches only; used to group fixtures into yearly competitions. Attribute snapshots use dates, not season strings.

name: Match Stage
definition: The integer round number within a season held in Match.stage, taking values 1 to 38 and corresponding to the matchday of the fixture.
scope: Applies to matches only; the number of populated stages differs by league because league sizes differ.

name: Home or Away Side
definition: The venue role of a team in a match, encoded by which of the two mirrored column groups holds the team: home_team_api_id with home_team_goal, or away_team_api_id with away_team_goal.
scope: Applies to any per-team metric derived from Match; the same team can appear as the home side in one row and the away side in another.

name: Match Event Feed
definition: The XML event payload attached to a match in the eight Match columns goal, shoton, shotoff, foulcommit, card, cross, corner and possession. Each column holds a root element containing one <value> element per incident.
scope: Present as a whole or absent as a whole: all eight columns are NULL together for 11762 matches. Availability is concentrated in England, Germany, Italy and Spain, and is partial in France, Netherlands, Switzerland, Scotland and Poland.

name: Match Event
definition: A single timed incident inside a match, for example a goal, a card or a shot, described by the <value> elements of the event feed with elapsed minute, team and player references.
scope: Only meaningful for matches that carry a populated event feed.

name: Goal Event
definition: A match event of goal type recorded in Match.goal, carrying elapsed minute, scoring team, player1, optional assisting player2 and a goal_type discriminator.
scope: Populated only where the match event feed exists; the event count does not always agree with the final scoreline.

name: Card Event
definition: A disciplinary match event recorded in Match.card, discriminated by card_type into yellow, red and second yellow.
scope: Populated only where the match event feed exists. An empty payload is encoded as an empty root element rather than a NULL.

name: Possession Snapshot
definition: A cumulative in-match possession measurement recorded in Match.possession, holding homepos and awaypos at a given elapsed minute.
scope: Populated only where the match event feed exists; roughly four snapshots per match at elapsed minutes near 25, 45, 70 and 90.

name: Player Ability Snapshot
definition: One dated FIFA rating record for a player in Player_Attributes, holding overall_rating, potential, physical skills, work rates and preferred foot as at that date.
scope: Grain is player crossed with snapshot date, about two snapshots per player per year. It is not a match-level or season-level record.

name: Team Tactical Snapshot
definition: One dated tactical profile for a team in Team_Attributes, holding build-up, chance-creation and defence settings as numeric values plus their class labels.
scope: Grain is team crossed with snapshot date; only six snapshot dates exist between 2010 and 2015 and only 288 of 299 teams are covered.

name: Player API Identifier
definition: The primary player key player_api_id, used by Player, by Player_Attributes and by the 22 lineup columns of Match.
scope: The join key for any player-level analysis that starts from a match. Distinct from Player.id, which is an internal row counter never referenced elsewhere.

name: Player FIFA Identifier
definition: The second player key player_fifa_api_id, the identifier of the player in the FIFA video game, held on both Player and Player_Attributes.
scope: Alternative player identity with a value domain disjoint from player_api_id; use it only when the question is framed in FIFA identifiers.

name: Team API Identifier
definition: The primary team key team_api_id, used by Team, by Team_Attributes, by Match.home_team_api_id and away_team_api_id, and by the team element inside the event feed.
scope: The join key for any team-level analysis that starts from a match.

name: Team FIFA Identifier
definition: The second team key team_fifa_api_id, the identifier of the club in the FIFA video game, held on both Team and Team_Attributes.
scope: Alternative team identity with a value domain disjoint from team_api_id; NULL for 11 of 299 teams.

name: Player Date of Birth
definition: The player birth date stored as TEXT in Player.birthday.
scope: One value per player; the source concept from which player age is computed.

name: Goals Scored
definition: The number of goals credited to a team in a match, held as the authoritative scoreline in Match.home_team_goal for the home side and Match.away_team_goal for the away side.
scope: Available for every one of the 25979 matches regardless of event-feed coverage. This is the scoreline of record; it is not guaranteed to equal the number of goal events in the feed.

name: Match Outcome
definition: The result of a match from one side's perspective, being a win, a draw or a loss, determined by comparing that side's goals scored with the opponent's.
scope: Defined per match and per side; must be computed from home_team_goal and away_team_goal rather than derived from the event feed.

name: Goal Difference
definition: Goals scored minus goals conceded by a team, aggregated over a chosen set of matches such as a season or a venue role.
scope: Computed from home_team_goal and away_team_goal; the sign depends on which side is used as the reference team.

name: League Points
definition: The competition points a team accumulates over a set of matches, obtained by converting each match outcome into a points value and summing.
scope: Requires an explicit points convention plus a scope such as one league and one season; not stored as a column anywhere in the database.

name: Overall Rating
definition: The FIFA overall ability score of a player at a snapshot date, held in Player_Attributes.overall_rating on a scale observed from 33 to 94.
scope: Snapshot-level, not match-level; a player has one value per snapshot date, about twice a year.

name: Player Potential
definition: The FIFA ceiling ability score of a player at a snapshot date, held in Player_Attributes.potential.
scope: Snapshot-level; conceptually related to overall rating but not computed from it.

name: Player Age
definition: The age of a player at a reference point in time, computed from the player date of birth and that reference date.
scope: Depends on the chosen reference date; when analysing a match or a snapshot the reference date must be stated explicitly.

name: Player Work Rate
definition: The categorical intensity with which a player works when attacking and when defending, held in Player_Attributes.attacking_work_rate and Player_Attributes.defensive_work_rate.
scope: Intended domain is low, medium and high, but a substantial minority of rows carry values outside that domain or are empty.

name: Bet365 1X2 Odds
definition: The Bet365 pre-match decimal odds for the three match outcomes, held in Match.B365H for the home win, Match.B365D for the draw and Match.B365A for the away win.
scope: Available for all eight seasons; absent for every match of Switzerland Super League and Poland Ekstraklasa.

name: Pinnacle 1X2 Odds
definition: The Pinnacle pre-match decimal odds for the three match outcomes, held in Match.PSH, Match.PSD and Match.PSA.
scope: Available only from season 2012/2013 onward; NULL for all earlier seasons.

name: Implied Outcome Probability
definition: The probability of a match outcome implied by a set of decimal odds, obtained by inverting the odds and normalising across the three outcomes.
scope: Derived from a chosen bookmaker family; the choice of family determines the seasons and leagues for which the metric exists.

name: Possession Share
definition: The share of ball possession held by a side, read from the homepos and awaypos values of Match.possession, which sum to 100 within each snapshot.
scope: Available only for matches carrying the event feed; the last snapshot in elapsed order represents the match-level figure.

name: Shots on Target
definition: The number of shots on target recorded for a side, obtained by counting the qualifying shot events inside Match.shoton.
scope: Available only for matches carrying the event feed; the column holds event markup rather than a scalar count, so the metric must be aggregated from the payload.

name: Card Count
definition: The number of disciplinary cards shown in a match, obtained by counting the card events inside Match.card and splitting them by card_type.
scope: Available only for matches carrying the event feed. An empty card payload means no cards, which is different from the column being NULL.

name: Country Name
definition: The human-readable country label in Country.name, unique across the 11 rows.
scope: Use for labelling a country; do not use as a join key since League carries no country name.
